entities.name: UE usage setting change
entities.description: Procedure executed when the UE's usage setting changes between voice-centric and data-centric modes. The specific actions depend on the UE's mode of operation and current conditions.

entities.name: Disable E-UTRA capability
entities.description: Procedure to disable the E-UTRA capability of the UE, typically triggered when changing from data-centric to voice-centric usage setting under specific conditions.

entities.name: Re-enable E-UTRA capability
entities.description: Procedure to re-enable the E-UTRA capability of the UE, triggered when changing from voice-centric to data-centric usage setting and E-UTRA is currently disabled.

entities.name: Combined tracking area update with IMSI attach
entities.description: Procedure executed when voice domain selection results in an attempt to stay in E-UTRAN during usage setting change from data-centric to voice-centric.

entities.name: Voice-centric usage setting
entities.description: UE usage setting where voice services are prioritized over data services.

entities.name: Data-centric usage setting
entities.description: UE usage setting where data services are prioritized over voice services.

entities.name: IMS voice not available
entities.description: Condition indicating that IMS voice services are not available to the UE.

entities.name: CS fallback not available
entities.description: Condition indicating that CS fallback is not available, includes EMM causes #16, #17, and #18.

entities.name: CS fallback not preferred or SMS only
entities.description: Condition where the UE received a CS fallback not preferred or SMS only indication during the last successful combined attach or combined tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: E-UTRA is disabled
entities.description: Condition indicating that the E-UTRA capability of the UE is currently disabled.

entities.name: Voice domain selection to different RAT
entities.description: Condition where voice domain selection results in selection to a different radio access technology.

entities.name: Voice domain selection to stay in E-UTRAN
entities.description: Condition where voice domain selection results in attempt to stay in E-UTRAN.
